Saturate

The image transitions from natural saturation to boosted saturation on hover/focus.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.saturate img{
  filter: saturate(1);
  transition: filter 0.5s ease;
}
.hover-effect.saturate:hover img,
.hover-effect.saturate:focus-visible img{
  filter: saturate(2.5);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hover-effect.saturate img{
    transition: none;
  }
  .hover-effect.saturate:hover img,
  .hover-effect.saturate:focus-visible img{
    filter: saturate(2.5);
  }
}

The animates filter: saturate() from 1 to 2.5. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
